raw_text: Confirmed: Wagner PMC convoy of approximately 40 vehicles including BTR-82A APCs photographed on M4 near Voronezh Oblast border. Column heading northeast at speed. No Russian MoD checkpoints observed stopping the movement. Satellite pass from 1400 UTC confirms vehicle positions.
